lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Baird upgraded Deere to Outperform with an $800 target and analyst David Raso lifted his target to $813, citing recovering farm income, aging equipment and a 2027 replacement cycle; the stock gained 3.9% on the calls.
providers.risk: The stock already trades roughly 60% above GF Value estimates, so any wobble in the ag-cycle recovery narrative could trigger a sharp pullback.
